brief.text: Arsenal's legal offensive against Man City over the 114 charges is heating up, with the club reportedly zeroing in on five specific transfers as key evidence; this one has legs and could reshape the whole landscape if City are found guilty. On the pitch, Wednesday night's draw away to Dortmund was frustrating but results elsewhere actually improved our Champions League knockout picture, so it is not all doom and gloom. Transfer-wise, Monza have slapped a minimum £25m tag on their man linked with us, Inter are sniffing around Mosquera but a January move looks unlikely, and there are whispers we have made direct contact with another target's club, though all three sit firmly in rumour territory for now. Martinelli's return timeline is still being assessed, and with one or two players seemingly edging towards the exit in January, Arteta may need the window to work both ways.
